result_text:
I fixed the "past 90d" block so it shows the main LOC of repositories with commits in the past 90 days. I didn't compile or run any tests.

The block was passing `loc180Days` to its LOC text while the percentage already used `loc90Days`. I changed the LOC text to `loc90Days`. The change is one line in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportOverviewSection.java`, in `addBigRepositoriesSummary`.
